title: 第284章 遇故人第283章 崆峒仙山
slug: 别人修仙我闲逛游历三界终长生
content_zh:
韩松微微点头，神色舒张了不少，随即又郑重叮嘱道：
“仙道会开启在即，九州各道仙友齐聚，人流庞杂，你等守山门职责最重，万万不可松懈。”
“往后几日严守门禁结界，细查往来行人。”
“既要以礼善待各道仙友，亦要严防奸邪混入山中，务必保证仙道盛会安然召开。”
“若遇邪魔外道，可随时传讯与我。”
“是，韩长老，我等谨记！”
守山弟子躬身领命，神色郑重。
交代完山门值守要务，韩松回身看向纪风一行人，神色重归温和儒雅，拱手行礼道：
“纪仙友、诸位仙友，山中筹办仙会，贫道琐事缠身，还需即刻赶回主殿理事，无法全程陪同游览，失礼之处还望海涵。”
纪风等人回礼道：
“韩仙友自去操劳正事便可，我等随意休憩，无需挂怀。”
韩松点了点头，随后转头朝一旁的鹤鸣嘱咐道：
“仙道会正式启幕还需数日光景，山中主殿会务繁杂，九宫暂未对外开放。”
“你将装有甘露泉水的玉葫芦交给清荷，由她带往问道宫，准备烹茶事宜。”
“你引路，将纪仙友等人带往山中静舍安顿休憩。”
“沿途礼数要周全，妥善安置几位仙友，万万不可怠慢半分。”
鹤鸣肃然领命，朝韩松拱手道：
“弟子明白！”
随后鹤鸣将手中的青纹玉葫芦交给一旁的清荷。
韩松再度朝纪风等人颔首，又低声叮嘱了鹤鸣几句待客细节，才转身踏入山门，匆匆赶往主殿处置仙会筹备事宜。

“纪前辈，这边请！”
在鹤鸣的引路下，纪风等人穿过山门，沿石阶朝崆峒山上缓步走去。
石阶两侧全是参天古松，树枝遮天蔽日。
林间遍布灵植、灵花，山风穿林而过，带着一股草木花香。
不时有山中生灵跑过，打量着众人，丝毫不怕生人。
越往上走，两侧的树木逐渐稀疏，视野也逐渐开阔，能看到远处的山峰。
七十二座灵峰错落有致的矗立在大地上，峰峰翠绿，山腰间云雾缭绕。
山间殿宇依峰临云而建，朱檐黛瓦、重楼古殿隐于苍松云海之间，层楼叠榭，飞阁流丹，宛如仙境。
纪风等人走过山道，看到不少已经提前到达的各道仙友。
一棵古松旁，一位老道长盘膝闭目，端坐于青石之上，周身灵气缓缓流转，哪怕来参加仙道盛会也不忘修行、领悟大道。
不远处，几位修士三两结伴，缓步闲谈，有的说这些年闭关的感悟，有的问旧友近况，语气轻缓，笑意温和。
山崖边还有一道身影独自伫立，负手远眺云海千山，衣袍被山风吹得轻轻飘起。
知白拉了拉桃枝枝的衣袖，说道：
“枝枝，你说这位道长在想什么？”
“想他曾经的好友，这次仙道会会不会来？”
纪风等人走过后，那位道长看着远处的云，喃喃道：
“妙红一，希望这次仙道会，你会来。”
“这次，我不会再败在你手下。”
......
前来仙道会的各道仙友衣着、道法、气质各不相同。

但都遵守着仙道会的规矩，没有随意的斗法争吵，整座崆峒山处于静而不寂、繁而不乱的氛围之中。
所有人都在静候仙道会的开幕。
在鹤鸣的带领下，纪风等人来到崆峒山为各方仙友准备的静舍。
眼前一片房屋依灵峰而建。
content_en:
Han Song nodded slightly, his expression relaxed a lot, and then solemnly warned:
"The Immortal Association is about to start. Immortal friends from all the nine states will gather together. There will be a huge crowd. You and others have the most important duty to guard the mountain gate. You must not relax."
"In the next few days, we will strictly guard the entrance barrier and carefully check the people coming and going."
"We must not only treat our fellow immortals with courtesy and kindness, but also strictly prevent evil spirits from sneaking into the mountains. We must ensure that the grand gathering of immortals is held safely."
"If you encounter evil spirits and heretics, you can call me at any time."
"Yes, Elder Han, we will keep this in mind!"
The disciple guarding the mountain bowed to accept the order with a solemn expression.
After explaining the important tasks of guarding the mountain gate, Han Song turned around and looked at Ji Feng and his party, his expression returned to gentle and elegant, he raised his hands and saluted:
"Fellow Immortal Ji, fellow immortals, we are organizing an immortal meeting in the mountains. I am busy with trivial matters. I need to rush back to the main hall immediately to be a director. I cannot accompany you throughout the tour. Please forgive me for any rudeness."
Ji Feng and others returned the greeting:
"Friend Han Xian, just go and do your business. We can rest as we please without worrying about anything."
Han Song nodded, then turned to He Ming and said:
"It will take a few days for the Immortal Association to officially open. The main hall in the mountain has complicated affairs, and the Nine Palaces are not open to the public yet."
"You hand the jade gourd containing the nectar spring water to Qinghe, and she takes it to the Taoist Palace to prepare for making tea."
"You lead the way and take Ji Xianyou and others to a quiet house in the mountains to settle down and rest."
"Be careful with etiquette along the way, and properly arrange a few immortal friends. Don't neglect even a little bit."
He Ming solemnly accepted the order, cupped his hands towards Han Song and said:
"Disciple understands!"
Heming then handed the green jade gourd in his hand to Qinghe who was standing aside.
Han Song nodded to Jifeng and others again, and whispered a few details to Heming about hospitality, then turned around and stepped into the mountain gate, hurried to the main hall to deal with the preparations for the Immortal Association.
"Senior Ji, please come this way!"
Under the guidance of Heming, Ji Feng and others walked through the mountain gate and walked slowly along the stone steps towards Kongtong Mountain.
Both sides of the stone steps are lined with towering ancient pines, their branches blocking out the sky and the sun.
The forest is full of spiritual plants and flowers, and the mountain breeze passes through the forest, carrying a scent of vegetation and flowers.
From time to time, creatures from the mountains ran past and looked at everyone, showing no fear of strangers.
As we go higher, the trees on both sides gradually become sparse, and the view gradually broadens, and we can see the distant peaks.
Seventy-two spiritual peaks stand on the ground in an orderly manner. The peaks are green and the mountainside is shrouded in clouds and mist.
The palaces in the mountains are built according to the peaks and facing the clouds. The ancient palaces with red eaves and black tiles and double towers are hidden among the sea of ​​pines and clouds. There are pavilions on top of each other, flying pavilions and flowing elixirs, just like a fairyland.
Ji Feng and others walked through the mountain road and saw many immortal friends from various walks of life who had arrived in advance.
Next to an ancient pine, an old Taoist priest sat cross-legged and closed his eyes on the bluestone. The spiritual energy around his body slowly circulated. He did not forget to practice and understand the Tao even if he came to attend a grand gathering of immortal Taoism.
Not far away, several monks were chatting slowly in groups. Some talked about their experiences in seclusion over the years, and some asked about the current situation of old friends. Their voices were soft and their smiles were gentle.
There is another figure standing alone on the edge of the cliff, with his hands behind his hands, looking at the sea of ​​clouds and mountains, his robe gently fluttering in the mountain wind.
Zhibai pulled Taozhizhi’s sleeves and said:
"Zhizhi, what do you think this Taoist priest is thinking about?"
"Thinking about his former friend, will he come to this immortal meeting?"
After Ji Feng and others passed by, the Taoist priest looked at the clouds in the distance and murmured:
"Miao Hongyi, I hope you will come to this Immortal Meeting."
"This time, I will not be defeated by you again."
...
The immortal friends who come to the Immortal Association have different clothes, Taoism, and temperaments.
But they all abide by the rules of the Immortal Society, there are no random fights and quarrels, and the entire Kongtong Mountain is in an atmosphere of silence but not silence, complexity but not chaos.
Everyone is waiting for the opening of the Fairyland.
Under the leadership of Heming, Ji Feng and others came to the quiet house prepared for immortal friends from all walks of life in Kongtong Mountain.
In front of you is a group of houses built according to Lingfeng.
